newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Land posts slower growth in H1.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Land posts slower growth in H1.

text.p: Real estate giant Ayala Land Inc said on Wednesday it registered a five percent rise in net income in the first six months of this year to 2.66 billion pesos from 2.54 billion in the year-earlier period.
This is a lower growth compared with the 52 percent increase it posted in the same period last year when there was a real estate boom.
Its consolidated revenues in the first half fell to 6.83 billion pesos versus 7.46 billion in the like-period last year.

Of the Ayala Land group revenues of 6.83 billion pesos, 4.96 billion pesos came from real estate operations, 1.42 billion from interest and other income, and 427 million from hotel operations, the firm said.
Capital gains from the sale of shares in a landholding company were also realised in the first quarter.
Of the 4.96 billion pesos of real estate revenues, 1.57 billion pesos came from the sale of office and high-rise residential projects.
This was followed by land sales of 1.21 billion pesos, rental revenues of 1.07 billion, construction earnings of 715 million, and middle-income housing sales of 402 million.
"We are equally confident about our prospects in the coming years. We continue to explore business opportunities locally as well as in the Asia Pacific region," Ayala Land said.
